rationale: The benchmark candidate is structured_delivery because the supplied scope introduces product semantics and affects runtime and architecture across six canonical owners and eight source paths. This is broad, cross-owner delivery rather than a bounded compact path. The classification is read-only, non-authorizing, and is not an operative Mode/Slice Decision.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement only.
The scope spans 6 canonical owners, 8 source paths, and 8 derived paths.
Deterministic propagation is false despite derived paths being present.
compact_delivery is ineligible because no completed Brownfield analysis or stored quick_task context is supplied.
verified_change is ineligible because it requires exactly one canonical owner, no architecture impact, and deterministic
Any broader impact than the supplied facts requires fail-closed escalation.
